none: PAS BM-E2126C: BM-E2126C: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the second or third century AD. The sealing is rectangular in shape and section. Both the upper and the lower surfaces have legends in relief. The legend on the upper surface reads 'L.VI'. The legend on the lower surface is situated within a rectangular panel and right angles to the one on the upper surface. It reads 'LIA/E' below.
